notes: Published curves are SVO's LSST/LSST.*, which equal lsst/throughputs release 1.5 baseline/total_<b>.dat to 5e-7 (filter x m1-m3 x lens1-3 x detector x atmos_std, X=1.2). Components are that release's (tag 1.5), with Rubin's time-averaged ten-year losses, so filter x optics x qe x lsst_std(X=1.2) reproduces the published curves. Earlier builds put release 1.9.2 components here (components/*/<name>.dat without the _v1p5 suffix; kept on disk, no longer registered); release 1.9 is instrument LSST/LSSTv19. Atmosphere site 'lsst_std': baseline/README.md: 'atmos_std.dat is a fiducial atmosphere throughput at Rubin at 1.2 airmasses' (the same README also calls it 'the zenith atmos_std.dat atmosphere'). atmos_10.dat is X=1.0: the syseng_throughputs section of that README says 'To represent zenith, optimum throughputs, the X=1.0, with aerosols [atmosphere](./siteProperties/atmos_10_aerosol.dat) curve should be used', and atmos_10.dat equals that file at the sha1 in its header except the 1150 nm sample; ln T(atmos_std)/ln T(atmos_10) has median 1.199.

sources.optics: product of lsst/throughputs 1.5 baseline/m1.dat, lsst/throughputs 1.5 baseline/m2.dat, lsst/throughputs 1.5 baseline/m3.dat, lsst/throughputs 1.5 baseline/lens1.dat, lsst/throughputs 1.5 baseline/lens2.dat, lsst/throughputs 1.5 baseline/lens3.dat
